Short phase guidance on waiting areas
Staff will learn what applies on every shift

Companion Animal Travel Desk Waiting Area Practice

This section sets the standard for courteous waiting-area conduct so passengers and animals receive calm, consistent support before travel. Staff must keep the area orderly, speak in a steady manner, and guide each passenger through the required checks without delay or confusion. <<FACT F087>> The welcome team should watch for signs of distress, offer brief reassurance, and keep movement through the desk area controlled. Animals must remain attended, and staff should confirm that carriers, paperwork, and passenger instructions are handled with care.

When a passenger needs help at arrival, staff should listen closely, record the concern, and pass the matter to the proper channel without argument. <<FACT F107>> If a passenger is uncertain, the senior coordinator should be alerted at once so the issue can be resolved in a respectful and practical way. Every interaction must preserve safety, privacy, and dignity for the traveler and the animal. For further direction, contact the senior coordinator or the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
